spells.description: Chance on hit: Blasts a target for 42 Fire damage.

primaries.description: Higher leatherworking skill allows you to learn higher level leatherworking patterns.  Leatherworking patterns can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.
primaries.name: Leatherworking

primaries.description: Higher skinning skill allows you to skin hides from higher level monsters around the world.    Once your skill is above 100, you can divide your skill by 5 to determine the highest level of monster you can skin.
primaries.name: Skinning

secondaries.description: Higher cooking skill allows you to learn higher level cooking recipes.  Recipes can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and as drops from monsters.
secondaries.name: Cooking

secondaries.description: Higher fishing skill increases your chance of catching fish in bodies of water around the world.  If you are having trouble catching fish in a given area, move to a lower level area or purchase a fishing lure and try again.
secondaries.name: Fishing

talents.description: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 4 Rage or Energy.
talents.name: Ferocity

talents.description: Gives you a 40% chance to gain 10 Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores 40% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus 4 Energy per second spent outside Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, up to 40 Energy.
talents.name: Furor

talents.description: Increases your Intellect by 2%.  In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by 4% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by 2%.
talents.name: Heart of the Wild
